title: 아포칼립스 Z: 종말의 시작
ctx: 영화 「Apocalipsis Z: El principio del fin」(2024, 아마존 프라임 비디오 스페인 오리지널, 한국 제목 「아포칼립스 Z: 종말의 시작」, 감독 Carles Torrens, 원작 Manel Loureiro 소설). Francisco Ortiz as Manel, a lawyer in Galicia who lost his pregnant wife Marta in a car accident a year earlier and lives alone with his cat Lúculo; a rabies-like virus from Russia turns people into fast zombies; Manel barricades in his house, then sails his boat south; he meets Lucía (Iria del Río), a young woman, and other survivors; Belén, his neighbor; the old man Ukrainian pilot Pritchenko (helicopter pilot); they head to the Canary Islands, the last safe zone. Spanish audio.
